headSHASemantics: This is the exact package and test commit. The documentation-only evidence commit does not change package or test code.
scope: A local, static Excalidraw WebView package. The package has a read-only input bridge and pan and zoom view controls.

success: The validator accepts the reviewed package and the registry matches an Excalidraw version 2 artifact.
The package declares only inputRead and externalLink capabilities.
The static viewer has pointer pan, bounded wheel zoom, bounded keyboard pan and zoom, and a visible focus style.
error: An unsupported Excalidraw version has no registry match.
The validator rejects a changed viewer.js asset with assetHashMismatch.
boundary: The test checks that the manifest lists every package file except manifest.json.
The test checks the total declared asset size against RendererPackageValidationLimits.maximumCopiedByteCount.
The descriptor input bound does not exceed WikiAppWebViewPolicy.maximumBridgeInputPayloadByteCount.
The test rejects fetch, network sockets, workers, dynamic imports, dynamic evaluation, writable browser storage, clipboard access, document.write, and contentEditable source patterns.
coverage.cancellation: Not applicable. The package test has no task or session lifecycle.
coverage.teardown: Each test deletes its isolated validator staging root.

bidirectionalResolution.command: inventory=plans/dynamic-renderers-phase6-excalidraw-package-test-inventory.json && jq -e '(.productionPaths | length > 0) and (.testPaths | length > 0) and all(.productionPaths[]; ((.path | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.symbols | type == "array" and length > 0) and (.tests | type == "array" and length > 0))) and all(.testPaths[]; type == "string" and length > 0)' "$inventory" >/dev/null && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory production path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.productionPaths[].path' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory test path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r testName; do functionName=${testName##*.}; matches=$(rg -l -F "func ${functionName}(" $(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$matches" -eq 1 || { echo "inventory test did not resolve exactly once: $testName" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '[.productionPaths[].tests[]] | unique[]' "$inventory")

excluded: Phase 5 host, WebView session, bridge, navigation, CSP, safe-mode, and trusted-activation contracts
JSON Canvas decoding and native UI
renderer package installation, management, rollback, and removal
new network policy, runtime dependency loading, workers, and writable source input
honestCoverageLimits: The viewer source test proves static source patterns and declared controls. It does not run a hosted WebKit interaction test.
The viewer supports a bounded subset of Excalidraw element shapes. It does not claim full Excalidraw compatibility.
The installed-renderer host preserves Source fallback, but this slice does not change or rerun host lifecycle tests.
The Phase 6 matcher reads only a bounded JSON prefix. Valid Excalidraw documents whose required signature falls outside that prefix keep Source fallback.
